what_it_does: This paper describes a specialized processor for fully homomorphic encryption (FHE), a cryptographic technique that allows computation on encrypted data—the server can run machine learning models on your private data without ever decrypting it. FHE is extremely powerful but today consumes enormous power and requires expensive, time-consuming operations called bootstrapping. This chip supports three popular FHE schemes (BGV, BFV, and CKKS, each suited to different workloads) and optimizes both client-side encryption and server-side computation. The key innovation is managing the massive internal data movement overhead that these schemes require, using architectural and circuit-level tricks to keep power consumption and area reasonable.
